finding: MAD is triggered by READ-projection ablation. Heretic only ablates write projections (attn.o_proj, mlp.down_proj) and therefore never triggers it, at any direction layer. The trigger manifests as prompt-conditional gibberish, NOT as capability collapse.
reading: DL sweep: GSM8K 0.376-0.397 at EVERY direction layer 8..26 (clean 0.3844) -- the collapse never fires under heretic's write-only shape, so the earlier 'heretic escapes to a low layer band' hypothesis is REFUTED; 14.31 is simply the peak of an attack-efficacy curve. Adding read projections to the SAME attack drops harm 0.3231 -> 0.0577 (82%) with gibberish 0.94 and GSM8K 0.3715 intact. Bad news: the attacker picks the attack, and adding read projections costs them 82% of yield, so heretic's write-only parameterisation is why it wins, not a handicap.
